historical_audit_basis.candidate_difference_rule: Every member is provenance only. Fresh candidate code, runner, runtime, dependency and command hashes may differ; P2 must never compare a candidate member hash with this object.
historical_audit_basis.superseded_fixed_alias_rule: The two 20260816_145644 archive members are byte-identical captures of the rejected Round-2 fixed MD/JSON pair before this revision and are the only non-self-referential way this revision binds those inputs.

plan_tracker_semantic_rebinding.effective_only_when: this amendment and a candidate covering the complete production/runner/runtime closure receive fresh independent acceptance
plan_tracker_semantic_rebinding.rule: At every named P05M interface in the hash-bound plan/tracker, any phrase naming or describing the legacy count-metric fixture receipt denotes the complete canonical temporac.p05m-gate-evidence.v1 object. The legacy six-key receipt remains mandatory only as gate_evidence.inner_summary_receipt and can never be supplied directly.

evaluator_executable_closure.authoritative_rule: The listed current digest and member hashes are historical provenance only. The accepted candidate index supplies the authoritative member records and recomputed whole-closure digest, which may differ.
evaluator_executable_closure.member_rule: For each member append uint64_be(path_ascii_byte_length), path_ascii, uint64_be(raw_file_byte_length), raw_file_bytes. Lengths are unsigned 64-bit big-endian; raw bytes are not decoded or normalized.
evaluator_executable_closure.whole_closure_rule: evaluator_code_sha256 is this complete 17-member closure digest, not a metrics/evaluator subset and not a concatenation of member digests

production_dependency_dag.candidate_rule: Fresh candidate review recomputes the complete local import edge array from candidate raw bytes, requires every target to be one of module_origins, records that exact array and digest in the candidate index, and rejects importlib, __import__ calls, exec/eval-created imports, path mutation before the origin audit, namespace packages, zipimport for pams, or any unlisted local origin.
production_dependency_dag.edge_order: ascending pair (importer UTF-8 bytes, imported UTF-8 bytes), with no duplicate pair
production_dependency_dag.package_execution_rule: Normal CPython import semantics are mandatory: importing any pams.temporac member first executes the exact candidate bytes for pams/__init__.py and then pams/temporac/__init__.py. No isolated-loader bypass is permitted.

evaluator_dependency_contract.direct_import_scope: The arrays constrain direct imports in the production closure. Transitive imports are permitted only when every loaded origin is inside an exact runtime-lock tree and appears in the process module-origin manifest.

role_origin_rules.controller: Only the exact runner member plus locked CPython built-in/frozen/stdlib origins may load; pams, NumPy and SciPy origins are forbidden.
role_origin_rules.production: The exact runner member, all actually imported 17-member production origins, and locked CPython/NumPy/SciPy origins may load; no other origin is permitted.
role_origin_rules.reference: The exact runner member, separately hashed reference source compiled with the frozen synthetic filename, and locked CPython/NumPy origins may load; pams and SciPy origins are forbidden.

evaluator_dependency_contract.transitive_closure_rule: The runtime lock contains the complete CPython executable/stdlib tree, complete installed NumPy and SciPy distribution trees plus wheels and RECORD files, and recursive native-image closure. Each controller/production/reference witness embeds the complete observed sys.modules origin manifest after scoring and before stdout serialization.

runtime_lock_contract.canonical_hash_rule: runtime_lock_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical runtime-lock JSON bytes with one terminal LF; the object contains no runtime_lock_sha256 field
runtime_lock_contract.gpu_rule: No GPU device node is mounted and CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES is the empty string.
runtime_lock_contract.module_origin_rule: Entries are sorted by module_name UTF-8 bytes and cover every non-null sys.modules entry after scoring and before stdout serialization. source/bytecode/extension origins bind exact raw files in a locked tree. built-in/frozen entries use origin_token=$PYTHON_EXECUTABLE_IMAGE, origin_relative_path built-in:<name> or frozen:<name>, and bind the exact executable bytes/hash. Reference additionally includes one required compiled-source pseudo-entry named temporac_p05m_reference_v1 with origin_token=$REFERENCE_SOURCE, origin_relative_path=<temporac-p05m-reference-v1>, and the exact reference source length/hash even if its execution dictionary was not inserted into sys.modules.
runtime_lock_contract.module_origin_manifest_hash_rule: module_origin_manifest_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical entry array plus one terminal LF; no entry or manifest contains that digest.
runtime_lock_contract.native_image_rule: The manifest includes the executable and every recursively resolved ELF interpreter, DT_NEEDED library and executable file mapping used by CPython, NumPy, SciPy or their extensions, ordered by (path_token, relative_path) UTF-8 bytes.
runtime_lock_contract.native_image_manifest_hash_rule: native_image_manifest_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical entry array plus one terminal LF and is the value required in every process witness.
runtime_lock_contract.network_rule: A fresh network namespace has no non-loopback interface and all socket creation/connect/bind syscalls are denied by the frozen sandbox profile.
runtime_lock_contract.path_token_rule: executable_path_token is exactly $RUNTIME/bin/python3.12; stdlib_root_token is $RUNTIME/stdlib; installed_root_token is $RUNTIME/site-packages; wheel_path_token is $RUNTIME/wheels/<wheel_filename>; record_relative_path is the unique distribution RECORD path relative to installed_root_token.
runtime_lock_contract.sys_path_activation_rule: With -I -S active, controller verifies the interpreter bootstrap paths, then replaces sys.path with sys_path_tokens_exact before any candidate-local, NumPy or SciPy import. Worker role imports occur only afterward. Any earlier third-party/local import, extra path, missing path, reordered path or origin mismatch is STOP-METRIC.
runtime_lock_contract.tree_preimage: ASCII tag temporac.p05m.runtime-tree.v1 followed by NUL, then for each relative path sorted by raw NFC UTF-8 bytes append uint64_be(path_byte_length), path_bytes, uint32_be(mode), uint64_be(raw_file_byte_length), raw_file_bytes. mode is exactly the low 12 POSIX permission bits as a nonnegative integer. Paths use forward slashes, are relative, contain neither empty, dot nor dot-dot segments, and raw bytes are not normalized.
runtime_lock_contract.tree_type_rule: Only directories and listed regular files may exist below a locked tree root; symlinks, hard links, devices, sockets and FIFOs are forbidden. Directories contribute no preimage member and are materialized mode 0555; every regular member appears exactly once.
runtime_lock_contract.wheel_rule: NumPy and SciPy installed trees must validate byte-for-byte against their exact locked RECORD bytes and separately bound wheel bytes; missing wheel, RECORD, installed member or recursive native image is STOP-METRIC.

sandbox_profile_contract.canonical_hash_rule: sandbox_profile_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical sandbox-profile JSON bytes with one terminal LF; the object contains no sandbox_profile_sha256 field

filesystem.candidate_mount: $CANDIDATE is the verified content-addressed snapshot, mounted read-only and noexec except for CPython reading the exact runner/source members
filesystem.runtime_mount: $RUNTIME is the exact runtime lock, mounted read-only
filesystem.work_mount: $WORK/empty is newly created, initially empty, private to the invocation and writable; no other filesystem mount is visible

sandbox_profile_contract.syscall_policy_rule: syscall_policy_base64 is the unique RFC 4648 standard-alphabet encoding with required padding and no whitespace; decoding must yield exactly the nonnegative integer syscall_policy_bytes and its SHA-256 must equal syscall_policy_sha256. A witness from each process proves those exact embedded bytes were active for its entire lifetime.

runner_executable_closure.dependency_rule: No repository-local helper outside the 17-member production closure may be imported or executed. Controller, production-worker and reference-worker role branches are in this one exact runner member and are audited under evaluator_dependency_contract.
runner_executable_closure.member_rule: For the sole member append uint64_be(path_ascii_byte_length), path_ascii, uint64_be(raw_file_byte_length), raw_file_bytes; raw bytes are not decoded or normalized.
runner_executable_closure.reference_embedding_rule: The runner contains an exact byte literal equal to the Markdown TEMPORAC_P05M_REFERENCE_SOURCE_V1 block; candidate review extracts both, verifies byte equality and reference_source_sha256 before accepting the runner.

candidate_conformance_index.authoritative_when: A separate fresh candidate-review receipt binds the exact canonical index bytes and accepts the complete production, runner, runtime, command, dependency, origin-policy and snapshot closure. Candidate values may differ from all historical hashes.
candidate_conformance_index.candidate_dependency_edge_rule: edges use the same unique sorted [importer, imported] pairs as the audited DAG contract; module_origins has exactly the fixed 17 module_name/path pairs; package_initialization_order is exactly [pams,pams.temporac]
candidate_conformance_index.candidate_id_rule: candidate_id is 1 through 128 lowercase ASCII characters matching [a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]* and is assigned before fresh review
candidate_conformance_index.candidate_snapshot_rule: The member order is the 17 production members followed by tests/temporac/test_p05m_fixture.py, using the same path/raw-length member encoding; no other repository byte is executable in P2 or K7.
candidate_conformance_index.command_template_hash_rule: Each command_templates role value obeys temporac.p05m-command-template.v1 and the same-role command_template_sha256s value hashes its complete canonical bytes plus one terminal LF.
candidate_conformance_index.embedded_hash_rule: Each embedded object is canonicalized independently with the amendment canonical-JSON rule; its adjacent sha256 field must equal those exact bytes.
candidate_conformance_index.member_object_rule: bytes is a nonnegative JSON integer equal to the following raw-file length; path is the exact ASCII member path at that array position; sha256 is 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters equal to the unchanged raw bytes.
candidate_conformance_index.no_self_hash: candidate_conformance_index_sha256 is absent and is computed only after canonical serialization

candidate_review_receipt.reviewed_scope: complete candidate index including all embedded closure/runtime/dependency/command/sandbox objects and both amendment output hashes

reviewer_witness_schema.identity_rule: amendment_author_identity_token, candidate_implementer_identity_token and reviewer_identity_token are three nonempty ASCII tokens and must be pairwise unequal; the reviewer assignment is issued by the independent review authority before review and binds reviewer, amendment and candidate index.
reviewer_witness_schema.reviewer_identity_rule: All identity tokens are opaque and assigned outside the candidate; they contain no account, host, credential or path secret. The reviewer process has read-only access to candidate bytes and cannot write candidate, runner, runtime, command or evidence inputs.

command_and_process_evidence.actual_command_rule: The only argv substitution is replacing the final literal <CHALLENGE_HEX_64> token by exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. The witness embeds actual_argv, and actual_argv_sha256 is the canonical JSON hash of that exact string array.
command_and_process_evidence.challenge_rule: P2 gate verifier creates the controller 32-byte challenge; the controller creates independent production/reference 32-byte challenges with os.urandom. All three must differ. Each child stdout and process witness binds its role challenge; the outer witness binds the controller challenge.
command_and_process_evidence.fresh_process_identity_preimage: ASCII temporac.p05m.process-identity.v1 plus NUL, uint64_be(pid), uint64_be(parent_pid), raw32(role_challenge), raw32(actual_argv_sha256), raw32(executable_sha256)

process_failure.transport: stdout is empty; stderr is exactly the canonical error object plus one terminal LF; no role observation, runner evidence or gate evidence exists

process_witness.controller_null_rule: For command_role=controller, observation_root_sha256 is 64 zeroes and runner_execution_evidence_sha256 is the exact canonical stdout object hash. For child roles, runner_execution_evidence_sha256 is 64 zeroes and observation_root_sha256 is the exact child stdout embedded root hash.
process_witness.observed_pid_rule: The parent compares pid with the OS process handle returned by spawn and parent_pid with its own OS pid; production and reference pids must differ from each other and from the controller pid.

sandbox_witness.witness_hash_rule: sandbox_witness_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete embedded canonical object plus one terminal LF; candidate/runtime/policy values must equal the accepted index. work_directory_initial_sha256 is SHA-256 of ASCII temporac.p05m.empty-directory.v1 followed by one NUL and no member bytes, exactly f5915c913731b3bd1e3487717bfa460cb3acf6798f0069eb9a5f9c9d05b5b29a.

observation_contract.attack_bytes_rule: attack_observed_sha256 hashes canonical temporac.count-metric-fixture-attack-expected.v1 bytes. Every one of the 17 scorer invocations must terminate with its exact error_code and GLOBAL_FAIL and must return no point, bootstrap, draw, row or partial payload.

observation_root.implementation_rule: production uses production_executable_closure_sha256; reference uses reference_source_sha256

role_observation.stdout_rule: The complete canonical role-observation bytes plus one LF are the child process's entire stdout and are hashed directly by its parent process witness.

construction_order: validate the runner request, candidate index, fresh candidate review, mandatory inner summary, all embedded object hashes, amendment commitments, runtime lock, command templates and immutable candidate snapshot
create distinct production/reference challenges and launch exactly one fresh child process for each role from its exact command template
send one canonical worker request to each child and require exit 0, empty stderr and stdout equal to one canonical role-observation object

verify actual argv/environment/executable/pid/parent/challenge/module origins/native images/sandbox/stdin/stdout in each process witness and cryptographically link each witness to its stdout observation root
require one normal call and all 17 attacks in each implementation; require both normal bytes, attack bytes, 288-row root and raw-f64 draw hashes equal the frozen commitments
only then emit one canonical runner-execution-evidence object with status OBSERVED_COMPLETE
runner_execution_evidence.no_pass_semantics: OBSERVED_COMPLETE is process evidence, not a P2 or gate PASS
runner_execution_evidence.stdout_rule: The controller process's entire stdout is exactly these canonical bytes plus one LF; its outer process witness hashes those bytes and the embedded runner_execution_evidence_sha256.

construction_order: P2 verifier validates the fresh candidate-review receipt and all exact embedded candidate/runtime/command/snapshot bytes
P2 verifier creates a fresh controller challenge and launches the exact outer runner once with the exact runner request on stdin
after exit it constructs and verifies the controller process witness, requiring stdout to equal the embedded runner-execution-evidence canonical bytes and hash
P2 verifier revalidates both linked child observations/witnesses, exact invocation counts, 288 rows, normal outputs, both 10000-draw raw roots and all 17 attack GLOBAL_FAIL outputs per implementation
P2 verifier embeds the mandatory inner summary and all surrounding evidence and only then writes status PASS
gate_evidence_receipt.hash_rule: gate_evidence_sha256 is computed externally from the complete canonical object; the object contains no self hash
gate_evidence_receipt.pass_semantics: This is the sole P05M gate input for P2, S0, G5a and K7. PASS means the fresh-review-bound outer runner and both role processes were actually executed and every closed equality was observed.

normal.estimate_rule: e=clamp(base_error_eighths[condition][arm][decimal_seed][component_index]+bias_eighths,0,8); estimate=count_gt-(count_gt*e//8); then exact stub override to zero

inner_hash_summary_receipt.mandatory_transport_rule: Exact canonical bytes and digest are mandatory at P2, embedded in gate evidence, committed by S0, revalidated at G5a and K7, and never accepted as a standalone gate input.
inner_hash_summary_receipt.mandatory_equality_rule: status is PASS; evaluator_code_sha256 equals the accepted candidate's complete production_executable_closure_sha256; fixture_input_sha256, expected_output_sha256 and attack_expected_global_fail_sha256 equal the amendment commitments. Any difference is STOP-METRIC.
inner_hash_summary_receipt.receipt_hash: SHA-256 over canonical JSON bytes including one terminal LF

status_semantics.GLOBAL_FAIL: An individual attack terminates the complete scorer atomically with its exact error code and returns no point, bootstrap, draw, row or partial payload.
status_semantics.PASS: The six hash fields are syntactically complete and mutually address frozen artifacts; no execution, review, P2, S0, G5a, K7, capability or launch conclusion follows.

reference_implementation.execution: The reference worker verifies the exact embedded LF-terminated ASCII source bytes, compiles with filename <temporac-p05m-reference-v1>, executes execute(fixture_input), and emits only the closed role observation.
forbidden: filesystem data access other than locked runtime/runner bytes
reference_implementation.independence: Production and reference run in distinct fresh processes with different role challenges. The production branch may not compile/import/call the reference; the reference branch may not import/call pams or SciPy.

runtime_contract.module_origin_rule: Every actual reference-process module origin is embedded in its witness and must resolve only to the exact runner, compiled reference source, locked CPython tree or locked NumPy 2.1.0 tree.
runtime_contract.runtime_lock_relation: Same exact runtime_lock object as the candidate, but the reference role forbids every pams and SciPy origin even though those trees are present for production.

reference_implementation.source_encoding: ASCII, LF line endings, exactly one terminal LF
reference_implementation.source_location: TEMPORAC_CONTRACT_AMENDMENT_003_P05M_FIXTURE.md block TEMPORAC_P05M_REFERENCE_SOURCE_V1 and exact embedded runner literal

P2: Treat historical_audit_basis only as provenance and use only a separately fresh-reviewed candidate index.
Require the mandatory six-key inner receipt as a subordinate hash summary, never as gate evidence.
Launch exactly one fresh outer controller process; it launches exactly one distinct production child and one distinct reference child, each executing one normal score and all 17 attacks.
Verify the complete linked process/observation chain and construct exactly one temporac.p05m-gate-evidence.v1 PASS object; no other P05M object can pass P2.
S0: Accept only the complete canonical temporac.p05m-gate-evidence.v1 bytes as the P05M gate input.

Before commit, recursively validate every closed nested object and hash, including the mandatory inner receipt, candidate/review, runner evidence, all three process witnesses, both role observations, runtime/module origins and snapshot.
Commit the exact gate-evidence bytes and external digest plus the immutable content-addressed candidate snapshot; there is no optional P05M artifact.
G5a: Load only the S0-bound gate evidence and immutable candidate snapshot; reject a standalone inner receipt.
Recompute all 17 production member raw bytes and the whole production closure, and require equality with candidate, P2 gate evidence and S0.
Write that exact whole-closure digest only into the existing closed evaluator_code_sha256 field; add no P05M key and compute no human statistic.
K7_prestart: Before constructing or starting the one-use evaluator process and before any capability-consumed transition, validate the exact S0-bound gate evidence recursively and verify its fresh candidate review.

Recompute the runner member, all 17 production members, dependency DAG, runtime trees, module-origin/native-image policies, command templates, candidate snapshot and every observation/process/root equality from the same immutable snapshot that will be launched.
Require gate evidence, S0, G5a and capability grant to agree on the complete production closure digest; missing/mismatch yields STOP-METRIC and consumes nothing.

After successful prestart verification, atomically start the sole non-resumable evaluator process from that verified read-only content-addressed snapshot; successful OS process creation is the only capability-consumption point. Then preserve the existing G5b to K7 order.

mismatches: metrics.py derives component order by bytewise token sort and paired_component_bootstrap accepts no explicit frozen component_order; the fixture order is intentionally nonlexical.

evaluator.py currently validates only the legacy six-key receipt and some target commitments before setting _consumed=True; it has no mandatory gate-evidence, runner/process/observation, complete-closure or immutable-snapshot K7 prestart validation.
count_metric_fixture_receipt hashes caller-provided bytes and emits PASS without executing production, reference or any attack.
gates.py can mark P2-METRIC PASS from arbitrary syntactically valid digest strings.
fixtures.py still names attack_global_fail_sha256 rather than the unique attack_expected_global_fail_sha256.
No tests/temporac/test_p05m_fixture.py outer runner exists in the audited current test set.
current_production_conformance.rule: All current hashes are provenance only and cannot populate an authoritative candidate index without implementation plus fresh independent review.

self_binding_policy.amendment: Neither amendment output contains its own digest. The later candidate-review receipt binds externally computed MD and JSON hashes.
self_binding_policy.candidate_index: Contains no candidate_conformance_index_sha256; review, runner request, runner evidence and gate evidence bind its external canonical digest.
self_binding_policy.evidence: Role observations do not contain stdout hashes; their parent witnesses bind stdout and observation roots. Runner evidence does not contain its own digest; the outer witness and gate evidence bind it. Gate evidence contains no gate_evidence_sha256; S0 binds it externally.
self_binding_policy.historical_separation: The pre-revision fixed pair is bound only through immutable timestamped archive members; current output paths are not members of their own historical basis.
self_binding_policy.rule: No PASS-bearing object can establish authority by validating only hashes it generated, by containing its own digest, or by accepting a sibling process/observation hash without the directional stdout link.

review.required_next_action: fresh independent review of both amendment outputs and, later, the complete candidate production/runner/runtime/orchestration closure before any implementation or gate claim
